comments.P: Clear proof-left/action-right spine and brand materials, but type is only “neutral grotesque”, signature is a name without mechanism, mobile-first journey is thin, and unknowns are undeclared despite thin evidence edges.
comments.Q: Full pick→hide→make-slot lock with mobile stack, price band, 3-week lead, named plates, shape lock, and honest missing stitch-macro — strongest complete build package; signature is solid but less singular than a bench ticket or hide strip.
comments.R: Saddlery bench ticket / gatefold is the most subject-true original concept and hierarchy is excellent; gatefold complexity is a real mobile-first risk if the closed face fails to carry trade facts.
comments.S: Newsletter/Content-First + Vibrant/Block-based with Rubik/Nunito and emerald/orange system palette fights pack brand, motion, and sensory leather ecommerce — template retrieval, not Northline.
comments.T: Plate-first make-slot desk with Hide Grade Strip matches hide-grade audience exactly; hex tokens, mono measurements, brass-only CTA, and honest missing-asset rules make it the cleanest ship candidate.
